Body.Content:
Multiple Baselines enables project managers to capture and maintain multiple snapshots of a project plan, providing a historical record of project execution and performance over time. Available for Project Operations Core and Project Operations connected with ERP. With this capability, project managers can: Create and manage multiple project baselines. Load and view any baseline directly within the project schedule. Compare baselines to evaluate plan evolution and track variances. Analyze changes in schedule, effort, and project progress against historical plans.

GA date: October CY2026
